observations: Title states MEDIAN_LOSS with R=-1.102 and outcome-disclosing; SELL geometry shows Entry ~1.2022 (blue), SL above ~1.2028 (red dashed), TP below ~1.2010 (green dashed).
Purple dotted break-bar open precedes blue dash-dot actual entry; between them a sharp red cascade drives price down through entry toward ~1.2020.
After actual entry the path is almost immediately adverse: green candles climb into the SL band; a purple X sits on the SL line near ~1.2028.
Post-exit price continues higher toward ~1.2030+; the TP line is never approached on the visible window.
Bottom CME 6E full-break-bar trace reports early=-0.119 late=-0.068 score=+0.066; actual entry is marked near ~300s from break-bar open.
Late-60s band (beige) shows direction-aligned I5 mostly around ~-0.1, while mid-window had stronger positive spikes.
unknowns: Exact fill price and whether any post-entry tick MFE below entry is material or just residual wick of the entry bar
Whether purple X is the precise SL fill timestamp/price or a stylized exit marker
Meaning/units of direction-aligned I5 and how score=+0.066 is computed from early/late negatives
Why actual entry is delayed to ~300s after break-bar open
result.entry_context_assessment: SELL is taken slightly after break-bar open on a completed downside cascade that already carried price through the entry level near a local low; the setup context is a failed downside break rather than entry into ongoing clean continuation.
result.path_anatomy: Break-bar open → red impulse through entry → actual fill near the impulse low → immediate reverse higher in green candles → SL touch (purple X, R≈-1.1) → continued adverse grind higher; no sustained sell continuation and no TP approach.
result.book_trace_relevance: Book trace is weakly mixed: overall score only +0.066 while early and late medians are negative, and late-60s alignment sits near -0.1 at the right edge where entry occurs; it does not show strong sustained direction support that would have separated a clean continuation winner from this reverse-to-SL path.
result.exit_geometry_assessment: Exit geometry is SL-bound: the purple X aligns with the fixed red SL; realized R=-1.102 matches near-full stop rather than TP, trail, or mid-path discretionary exit; TP remains far unused.
result.failure_mechanism: Downside break entry fails immediately after fill: price reverses through entry into the stop without accepting a continued sell path, producing a median-scale full-stop loss rather than continuation or staged giveback after a large favorable run.
